name: Senate Square
description: The city’s main neoclassical square, with the white, green-domed Helsinki Cathedral at the top of its wide steps.

name: Olympic Stadium
description: A white functionalist stadium built for the 1940 Olympics, which were cancelled; the Games came in 1952. Its tall tower has views over the city.

name: Oodi Central Library
description: A free public library opened in 2018 opposite Parliament, with a curved timber front, workshops with 3D printers and a big reading floor upstairs.

name: Finlandia Hall
description: A white marble concert and congress hall designed by Alvar Aalto, completed in 1971, on the shore of Töölö Bay.

name: Sibelius Monument
description: An abstract sculpture of hundreds of welded steel pipes, made in honour of the composer Jean Sibelius, in a small park by the sea.

name: Suomenlinna
description: An 18th-century sea fortress spread over a group of islands, a short ferry ride from the centre, with walls, tunnels, museums and cafés.

name: Hakaniemi Market
description: An open-air market square and its red-brick market hall from 1914, with stalls selling fish, meat, bread and Finnish food.
